item.text: {"summary":"A flowering shrub or small tree native to Europe and western Asia, and locally to northwest Africa, blackthorn has dark bark and dense, stiff, spiny branches. Its creamy-white flowers appear shortly before the leaves in early spring, followed by purple-black sloes that ripen in late autumn.
